rationale.edition: Most changed paths are OSS (`src/…` backend, `web/src/…` frontend), but the file list also touches enterprise-owned locations: `o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/super_cluster/queue/mod.rs` (super-cluster queue routing for report runs) and `o2_openfga/src/meta/route_permissions.rs` (OpenFGA RBAC route permissions for the new /reports/history endpoint). The feature spans both layers, so edition is "both".
rationale.skip: Not skipped. There is no `tests-added` label or skip request (trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are both empty), and the change is user-facing: it adds a History tab, a run drawer, a run-now dialog, and new report-run status UI under `web/src/**`.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The diff adds a new Reports History tab (`ReportHistory.vue`, `ReportRunHistory.vue`) plus a run drawer (`ReportRunDrawer.vue`) and a run-now dialog (`ReportRunNowDialog.vue`) — new user-exercisable flows whose interaction, status rendering, and URL state need verification.
rationale.area: Reports. The UI changes cluster in `web/src/components/reports/**`, `web/src/views/reports/**`, and `web/src/services/reports*`, and the sibling E2E specs already live under `tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Reports/` (reportsScheduleLater, reportsScheduleNow, scheduledReportsDrawer, etc.).
rationale.group: The closest existing matrix shard is the `Reports` testfolder (actual_folder `Reports`) in `tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix*.json`; it already groups the reports specs the new history spec belongs with.
rationale.existing_tests: The diff adds one Playwright E2E spec, `tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Reports/reportHistory.spec.js`, covering run-now writing a manual run into the History tab, the org-wide History tab, and cleanup. This is dev-authored E2E coverage for the new feature, so the route is enhance (Architect extends/complements it). The many changed `.spec.ts` files are Vitest unit tests and are not E2E coverage.
